Package edu.ucsb.cs.citelines.jobs

package edu.ucsb.cs.citelines.jobs
  • Related Packages
    Package
    Description
    edu.ucsb.cs.citelines
     
  • Classes
    Class
    Description
    BibTexEntryImproveJob
    Re-resolves whichever of a project's BibTeX entries the given BibTexEntryImproveJob.scope selects — the whole project, a single entry, or the references/citations of a single entry (see BibTexEntryImproveService.ImproveScope) — filling in any additional metadata a resolver now reports that an entry doesn't already have, via BibTexEntryImproveService.
    BulkCitationUploadFromACMDLViewAllJob
    Parses a pasted ACM DL "Cited By > View All" page and adds each citing paper as a new BibTeX entry citing the current one, via BulkCitationUploadFromACMDLViewAllService.
    BulkReferenceUploadFromACMDLJob
    Parses a pasted ACM DL References section and adds each reference as a new BibTeX entry cited by the current one, via BulkReferenceUploadFromACMDLService.
    CheckLinksJob
    Scans all BibTeX entries in a project and flags entries whose DOI/URL link looks broken, via CheckLinksService.
    DuplicateDetectionJob
    Scans all BibTeX entries in a project for likely duplicates and marks them for manual review, via DuplicateDetectionService.
    GetCitationsJob
    Fetches (and saves) the papers that cite a given BibTeX entry, via CitationGraphService.
    GetReferencesJob
    Fetches (and saves) the papers a given BibTeX entry cites, via CitationGraphService.
